name: Multi-level Partition-of-Unity RBF Interpolation
definition: An interpolation method that constructs a global approximation by blending local radial basis function (RBF) interpolants placed with the aid of an octree, reusing the octree structure computed for regularization.
summary: Multi-level Partition-of-Unity RBF Interpolation constructs global scalar fields from scattered data by blending local RBF interpolants within an octree, offering high quality and scalability unlike dense global methods.
